scope: Focused backdrop and ambient visual-asset pass only; no layout, component, brand, or runtime-integration changes proposed.
review_basis: Live landing-page review plus the existing stack stated in the brief: radial room gradients, topographic texture, paper grain, color pools, population dots, ember ripples, and rotating corner motifs.

findings.recommendation: Add a barely perceptible day-state wash behind the existing radial room gradient. The room should progress from a soft dawn-ochre bias on Day 1 to a tighter ember-brown core by Day 3 and a cooler, quieter umber perimeter by Day 5. This creates a legible five-day arc without introducing a new scene.
findings.implementation_note: CSS-friendly: keep the current room gradient intact; add one absolute pseudo-element below content with a 0.08–0.14 opacity linear/radial wash controlled by a day data attribute. Do not animate the wash more than 1–2px over 18–24 seconds.

findings.recommendation: Pair one existing corner motif with one new, smaller peripheral flourish per day rather than adding more illustrations at once. Suggested cadence: Day 1 sunrise wash, Day 2 folded note, Day 3 steam curl, Day 4 wilting plant, Day 5 ember-seed cluster. The pair should remain outside the central content corridor.
findings.implementation_note: Component-friendly: expose a day-to-motif map returning at most two motif IDs and four placement anchors. Render in a pointer-events-none ambient layer with z-index below cards and controls.

findings.recommendation: Introduce one or two translucent steam curls above an existing coffee or bowl motif. This is the most economical human-warm motion because it reinforces an object already on the page instead of asking the user to parse a new animation.
findings.implementation_note: SVG/CSS-friendly: use two stroked paths at 0.18–0.30 opacity; translate 6–10px vertically over 5.5–7 seconds with ease-in-out. Maintain a static 0.20 opacity state when motion is reduced.

findings.recommendation: Give the existing paper grain a microscopic frame shift rather than a conspicuous noise animation. It will remove digital stillness from large empty regions while preserving the page’s printed, tactile quality.
findings.implementation_note: CSS-friendly: background-position step changes of 1–2px every 5–8 seconds; grain opacity must remain at or below the current texture’s legibility threshold. Disable entirely under prefers-reduced-motion.

findings.recommendation: On Day 3 only, reveal one faint, offset contour island near an outer corner. Midweek is the right point for a small spatial change because the player is familiar with the room, while the field is beginning to narrow.
findings.implementation_note: SVG-friendly: use one irregular contour group at 0.06–0.09 opacity, 1px warm-gray stroke, and no motion. Place it behind the current topology with a mask that avoids the primary headline and card grid.

findings.recommendation: Let only a very small subset of existing population dots breathe once per long cycle, as if distant human presence is registering in the system. The effect should be sparse, not a particle field.
findings.implementation_note: CSS-friendly: select 3–5% of dots deterministically by seeded index; pulse scale from 1 to 1.18 and alpha by no more than 0.12 over 9–14 seconds. No positional motion and no randomization after first render.

findings.recommendation: Add a three-to-five seed ember cluster at a far bottom corner on Day 5. It should read as low, persistent heat—not a celebratory confetti effect—supporting the final survivor tension.
findings.implementation_note: SVG-friendly: five irregular soft circles in existing ember yellow/orange/red tones, 0.18–0.35 opacity, optional shared 12-second opacity pulse. Keep the group under 36px at 390px viewport width.

findings.recommendation: For the prelaunch/reservation state only, add a restrained horizon pin: a short, warm line with a tiny sun-disc glow at the upper edge. It quietly signals an approaching start without revising the hero.
findings.implementation_note: CSS/SVG-friendly: 48–64px group anchored at 6–8% from a top corner, 0.16 opacity, no animation. Remove it once Day 1 begins so the first-day sunrise wash can carry the transition.

top_5_highest_leverage_backdrop_upgrades.why: Creates the clearest daily variety while retaining the existing day-rotated motif pattern and requiring no component redesign.
top_5_highest_leverage_backdrop_upgrades.shippable_delta: One day-to-motif map plus four 64px-or-smaller SVG flourishes.

top_5_highest_leverage_backdrop_upgrades.why: Changes the emotional temperature of each day without adding visual density or competing with type.
top_5_highest_leverage_backdrop_upgrades.shippable_delta: One CSS custom property set and one low-opacity room pseudo-element.

top_5_highest_leverage_backdrop_upgrades.why: Adds motion where the user already expects warmth, with negligible layout and performance risk.
top_5_highest_leverage_backdrop_upgrades.shippable_delta: Two SVG paths and a single reduced-motion-safe keyframe.

top_5_highest_leverage_backdrop_upgrades.why: Removes stillness from open background space while preserving the paper/gouache surface.
top_5_highest_leverage_backdrop_upgrades.shippable_delta: A 2–3 keyframe background-position animation, disabled under reduced motion.

top_5_highest_leverage_backdrop_upgrades.why: Adds a single midweek discovery beat without changing cards, copy, or system modules.
top_5_highest_leverage_backdrop_upgrades.shippable_delta: One masked SVG contour group for Day 3 only.

motif_flourishes.placement: Top outer edge, biased away from countdown and headline centerline.
motif_flourishes.visual_spec: A 10–14% viewport-height horizontal wash with a broken gouache edge: pale straw at the inner edge, desaturated apricot at the outer edge, then transparent. No literal landscape or horizon illustration.
motif_flourishes.implementation_note: Render as a background image or inline SVG layer at 0.12–0.18 opacity; static by default.

motif_flourishes.placement: Bottom-right corner, 18–28px beyond the content rail, slightly cropped by viewport edge.
motif_flourishes.visual_spec: A warm ivory, imperfect quadrilateral with one folded triangle, three short charcoal-like scribble strokes, and a soft clay shadow. The marks must stay non-legible.
motif_flourishes.implementation_note: Render no larger than 42px on a 390px-wide view; static.

motif_flourishes.placement: Immediately above an already-present cup or bowl motif; never free-floating in the headline area.
motif_flourishes.visual_spec: Two irregular tapering S-curves in chalky cream, each with a slightly offset duplicate stroke to mimic dry gouache buildup.
motif_flourishes.implementation_note: Animate only the group’s vertical translate and opacity; individual paths should not wobble.

motif_flourishes.placement: Lower-left outer edge, behind the illustration field and clear of the first interactive card.
motif_flourishes.visual_spec: A compact clay pot, one bent olive stem, two bruised leaves, and one fallen leaf. Silhouette is heavier at the pot than the leaves to remain readable at 36–48px.
motif_flourishes.implementation_note: Render at 38–48px at 390px viewport width; static.

motif_flourishes.placement: Far lower-right edge or behind the lower stakes module, outside all tap targets.
motif_flourishes.visual_spec: Three to five tiny irregular circles in muted ember orange, dull gold, and brick red, with uneven edges and no sparkle-star shapes.
motif_flourishes.implementation_note: Use a single, low-amplitude opacity pulse only when reduced motion is not requested.

motion_budget.principle: Movement is peripheral evidence of life, not a second interface. No motion may compete with countdown digits, card labels, buttons, or survival-progress data.

allowed_motion.placement_rule: Only directly above an existing warm-object motif.
Full room layer only; never a foreground filter over copy.

allowed_motion.element: Existing ember ripples / day-five ember seeds
allowed_motion.placement_rule: One cluster at a time; no new particle system.

must_remain_still: All text, countdown digits, buttons, cards, chips, dot rows, progress bars, and monetary values.
Primary room gradients, topographic linework, corner object silhouettes, and all motif placement anchors.
Anything inside the central 64% of the mobile viewport width from hero through primary CTA.
motion_budget.prefers_reduced_motion: Set all ambient animations to none, retain static artwork at its intended resting opacity, and keep no animation-related layout or opacity transition. Do not replace ambient motion with a more prominent static effect.

what_not_to_change: Do not redesign the warm smoky room, its radial pools, or the restrained near-black panels; the contrast between tactile warmth and hard system modules is already the product’s strongest visual premise.
Do not introduce glassmorphism, purple gradients, glossy 3D treatments, stock photography, cinematic scenes, or a new illustration system.
Do not alter the condensed display typography, CTA hierarchy, proof-card treatment, system bars, population-dot logic, or day-card interaction model.
Do not put motifs in the primary reading corridor, over the hero title, behind countdown numerals, or within tap-target hit areas.
Do not use more than two ambient motif groups at once on mobile, and do not make day variation dependent on animation for comprehension.
acceptance_checks: At 390px-wide mobile viewport, the headline, countdown, proof-card labels, and CTA remain visibly cleaner than any ambient addition.
At rest, every new asset reads as a low-contrast peripheral cue rather than a new scene.
With reduced motion enabled, the page remains compositionally complete and has no perceptible animation.
No proposed asset introduces personal data, production secrets, or runtime dependencies.
